mapper.select: SELECT post_id, comment_count FROM post_comment_count WHERE post_id IN #{postId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO post_comment_count (post_id, comment_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{postId}, GREATEST(#{delta}, 0), NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE comment_count = GREATEST(0, comment_count + #{delta}), update_time = NOW()
